title: Astro Portal API v1 geographic light-pollution map tiles
description: GET /v1/sky-quality/map/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (a private server has no such route). One 256 × 256 Web Mercator PNG tile (RGBA) of the ESTIMATED zenith sky brightness of the region, cut on request from the installed sky-quality raster and coloured with the ramp of the free horizon layer (`horizonLightColor`: transparent at 21.6 mag/arcsec² and darker, strongest at 18.0 and brighter). Access: a device bearer, the web session, or a phone with no space by its anonymous bearer (its capabilities are those of its purchases; 429 `sky_light_map_rate_limited` with Retry-After beyond 1,200 tiles an hour per anonymous device or 3,000 per network origin), then the capability `planner.mosaic` (403 `capability_required` naming it otherwise). A tile outside the zoom range or the zoom's grid answers 400 `invalid_request`; without an installed raster 503 `sky_quality_unavailable` with Retry-After, like GET /v1/sky-quality. The success is the PNG itself with `headers`; this schema describes the path, the headers and the JSON error body, the only JSON the route answers.

x.description: 0 to 2^z − 1, west to east from 180° W.

y.description: 0 to 2^z − 1, north to south from 85.0511° N; written `{y}.png` in the path.

headers.description: The headers of a 200 (with the PNG) and of a 304 (on a matching If-None-Match, no body).

ETag.description: The renderer's version and the raster's checksum: every tile of one raster shares it; a new raster or renderer is a new tile.

capability.description: With `capability_required` only: the capability the map needs.
